none: PAS NLM-DB03A3: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constans from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANS PF AVG ; R/ GLORI A EXERCITVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constans (337-350), issue of 335-341, Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: GLORI A EXERCITVS. In exergue: TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.03mm, Weight: 1.10gms, die axis: 12
